plan.calculationScroll: Swipe the table to see all values.
plan.calculationRounding: Contributions are reconstructed from the rounded values returned by the server. Small rounding differences are possible; the overall score shown is the server result. Missing dimensions contribute no points and their weights are redistributed across the available dimensions.
plan.dimension.water: Fit between crop water needs, rainfall and the declared irrigation conditions.
plan.dimension.soil: Rotation structure, crop families, legumes and crop history. This is not a laboratory soil measurement.
plan.dimension.yield: Attainable-yield references relative to the candidate pool. This is not a harvest forecast; missing crops are omitted.
plan.dimension.risk: Climate exposure over feasible growing periods, evaluated using climate normals.

disclaimer.title: What this tool does not do
disclaimer.body: No profit forecasts, no guaranteed yields, no precise field soil tests. Reference data is regional; consult a local agronomist before costly decisions.
disclaimer.soil: Soil data are estimated from a global map, not a laboratory test.
disclaimer.calendar: A verified planting calendar for your location is not available; we will not guess dates.
disclaimer.yield: Yield is a model-based reference under specified management, not a prediction of your harvest.
disclaimer.anon: Your selected plan is saved in this browser. There is no login or cross-device sync.
disclaimer.profit: Profit and market forecasts are not available in this version.
disclaimer.similar: Similarity is based on re-evaluating the whole rotation; crops are not identical.
settings.clearedNote: Browser key cleared. Reload to start fresh; old data becomes unreachable.
welcome.sources.title: Scientific Provenance & Data Sources
welcome.sources.climatologyDesc: 30-year agroclimatological normals at 0.5° × 0.5° resolution. Provides daily & annual temperature and precipitation baselines.
welcome.sources.soilDesc: Global gridded 250m machine-learning soil property estimates for 0–30 cm topsoil: pH, organic carbon, texture fractions, and nitrogen.
welcome.sources.gaezDesc: AgERA5 multi-crop potential yield reference baselines. Provides qualitative suitability references, not financial forecasts.

welcome.cin.s1.title: Start with your
welcome.cin.s1.body: Field Shift helps you identify the field and define the exact area to analyze, so your insights are always based on the right land.
welcome.cin.s2.title: Tell us what
welcome.cin.s2.body: You share your farming context and priorities — irrigation, previous crops, goals — so Field Shift can tailor recommendations to your land.
welcome.cin.s3.title: Understand your
welcome.cin.s3.body: Field Shift uses Earth observation and agricultural insight to understand the field — from weather and soil to what crops are best suited for your land.
welcome.cin.s4.title: Explore your next
welcome.cin.s4.body: Your field is analyzed, conditions are clear, and rotation options are ready. Explore, compare, and customize the plan that fits your land and goals.
welcome.cin.s5.title: Your land.
welcome.cin.s5.body: Draw your field, explore the rotations that fit its conditions, and choose the plan that works for you — the decision stays yours.
